seoTitle: Use Reports in Smartsheet to Consolidate Sheets
metaDescription: Build a Smartsheet Report that pulls data across multiple sheets, apply filters and sorting, and share a live, consolidated project summary.
intro: A Smartsheet Report pulls rows from multiple sheets into a single, filterable view, which is far more useful than checking each sheet separately. This guide covers creating a report, filtering it down to what matters, and sharing it as a live dashboard.

steps.heading: Understand reports vs. sheets
steps.body: A report is a dynamic view that aggregates data from multiple sheets, unlike a standard static sheet grid.

steps.heading: Create a new report
steps.body: Select your target source sheets or entire folders to pull data from.

steps.heading: Choose your columns
steps.body: Use the Report Builder to select exactly which columns to display and map across different tracking layouts.

steps.heading: Set filter criteria
steps.body: Configure filters to surface specific data, such as tasks marked In Progress or assigned to a specific person.

steps.heading: Sort, group, and share
steps.body: Apply multi-tier sorting and grouping, then publish the report or embed it in a dashboard to keep your team aligned.

faq.question: How is a report different from a regular sheet?
faq.answer: A report pulls and aggregates rows from multiple source sheets or folders into one filterable view, rather than being its own static grid.

faq.question: Can I edit data directly from a report?
faq.answer: Yes, reports support live bi-directional syncing, so editing a row in the report updates the original sheet.

faq.question: Can I filter a report to show only overdue tasks?
faq.answer: Yes, advanced filter criteria let you surface only specific data, like tasks that are overdue or assigned to a particular owner.

faq.question: Can I share a report with people who don't use Smartsheet daily?
faq.answer: Yes, you can publish the live report or embed it into an executive dashboard for easy viewing.
